notes: Paper presents two NEW measured exclusion limits on hidden photons (dark photons with kinetic mixing chi): (1) AFM measurements from Refs. [12,13] constraining m_γ' in range ~0.1–10 eV with chi ≳ 10^-0.5 (red curve, Fig. 1); (2) Plimpton-Lawton experiment [14] constraining hidden photons at larger mass scales (purple curve, Fig. 1). Data points extracted from Fig. 1 log-log plot showing excluded regions. AFM bound covers ~50 nm to ~100 nm distance scales; Plimpton-Lawton covers ~10 cm scale. Both are laboratory-based tests of Coulomb's law deviations. The paper also shows projected improvements (black and orange curves in Figs. 6 and 8) but these are marked as projections, not measured limits. Coupling type is DarkPhoton because the paper explicitly discusses kinetic mixing chi of a hidden photon (Abelian U(1)_X boson) with the photon, and the exclusion plots use chi on the y-axis. The bounds mostly overlap with or reinforce existing astrophysical and spectroscopic constraints but provide direct laboratory confirmation. | selector: figure (sole candidate)
